user.description: First run the browser-login helper described in the [setup guide](https://github.com/slflowfoon/ha-eon-next#setup). Sign in on E.ON's page and enter the dedicated refresh token here. Do not use a token from an active phone or browser session. Your E.ON password is not stored.

reconfigure.description: Run the browser-login helper for {email} and enter its dedicated refresh token. Existing entities and history are retained.
reconfigure.title: Reconnect E.ON Next
